#| standalone: true

library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(units)
library(tidyterra)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)
library(sf)

options(scipen=999)

# --- 1. DATA LOADING ---
# Load base spatial data (Ensure shapefiles/ folder is in your repo)
stat_areas <- terra::vect("shapefiles/State_Stat_2004.shp")
stat_areas$STAT_AREA <- as.numeric(stat_areas$STAT_AREA)
stat_areas$area_m2 <- terra::expanse(stat_areas)
AK <- terra::vect("shapefiles/mv_alaska_1mil_py.shp")

# --- 2. UI DEFINITION ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Fleet Movement Model Dashboard"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("psc_bias", "PSC Hotspot Bias (Multiplier):", 
                  min = 1, max = 5, value = 2, step = 0.5),
      selectInput("closure_areas", "Select Closure Areas:",
                  choices = sort(unique(stat_areas$STAT_AREA)),
                  selected = c(665730, 665700, 655730, 655700),
                  multiple = TRUE),
      helpText("Adjust the slider to simulate higher PSC density inside the chosen areas.")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Weekly Catch Maps", plotOutput("gfPlot", height = "600px")),
        tabPanel("Weekly PSC Maps", plotOutput("pscPlot", height = "600px")),
        tabPanel("Annual Comparison", plotOutput("summaryPlot")),
        tabPanel("Data Table", tableOutput("summaryTable"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- 3. SERVER LOGIC ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  analysis_results <- reactive({
    req(input$closure_areas, input$psc_bias)
    
    current_closure_ids <- as.numeric(input$closure_areas)
    bias_factor <- input$psc_bias
    
    # Geometry Logic
    closure_poly <- subset(stat_areas, stat_areas$STAT_AREA %in% current_closure_ids)
    closure_agg <- terra::aggregate(closure_poly)
    non_closure <- stat_areas[!(stat_areas$STAT_AREA %in% current_closure_ids), ]
    
    dist_to_close <- terra::distance(non_closure, closure_agg)
    non_closure$dist_to_closure <- apply(dist_to_close, 1, min)
    sim_areas <- non_closure[order(non_closure$dist_to_closure), ] %>% 
                   head(20) %>% 
                   rbind(closure_poly)

    # Simulation Logic
    simulated_years <- c(2021, 2022, 2023)
    sim_list <- list()
    set.seed(123)
    for(i in simulated_years){
      week_seq <- seq.Date(from = as.Date(paste0(i, "-08-01")), by = "week", length.out = 5)
      for(week_date in as.character(week_seq)) {
        is_inside <- sim_areas$STAT_AREA %in% current_closure_ids
        wk_dat <- data.frame(
          STAT_AREA = sim_areas$STAT_AREA,
          YEAR = i,
          WEEK_END_DATE = week_date,
          CATCH_ACTIVITY_DATE = as.character(as.Date(week_date) - 2),
          PROCESSING_SECTOR = "X",
          GF_TOTAL_CATCH_MT = round(rnorm(nrow(sim_areas), mean = 50, sd = 10), 2)
        )
        wk_dat$PSC_TOTAL_COUNT <- ifelse(is_inside,
          round(rnorm(sum(is_inside), mean = 5 * bias_factor, sd = 2), 2),
          round(rnorm(sum(!is_inside), mean = 5, sd = 2), 2)
        )
        sim_list[[paste0(i, week_date)]] <- wk_dat
      }
    }
    
    catch_data <- do.call(rbind, sim_list)
    catch_data2 <- terra::merge(stat_areas, catch_data, by = "STAT_AREA", all.x = FALSE)

    # Redistribution Math
    closure_dates <- data.frame(
      YEAR = c(2021, 2022, 2023),
      PROCESSING_SECTOR = "X",
      closure_date = c('2021-07-01','2022-07-01', '2023-07-01')
    )

    catch_df <- as.data.frame(catch_data2)
    all_psc_dates <- catch_df %>%
      left_join(closure_dates, by = c("YEAR", "PROCESSING_SECTOR")) %>%
      mutate(
        impacted = ifelse(CATCH_ACTIVITY_DATE > closure_date, "yes", "no"),
        inside = ifelse(STAT_AREA %in% current_closure_ids, "yes", "no")
      )
    
    impacted_hauls <- all_psc_dates %>% filter(impacted == "yes")
    gf_inside <- impacted_hauls %>% filter(inside == "yes") %>%
      group_by(YEAR, WEEK_END_DATE, PROCESSING_SECTOR) %>%
      summarise(tons_gf_inside_wk = sum(GF_TOTAL_CATCH_MT), 
                psc_inside_wk = sum(PSC_TOTAL_COUNT), .groups = "drop")

    gf_outside <- impacted_hauls %>% filter(inside == "no")
    rates_props <- gf_outside %>%
      group_by(YEAR, WEEK_END_DATE, STAT_AREA, PROCESSING_SECTOR) %>%
      summarise(tons_gf_wk = sum(GF_TOTAL_CATCH_MT),
                mean_psc_rate_wk = sum(PSC_TOTAL_COUNT)/sum(GF_TOTAL_CATCH_MT), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(YEAR, WEEK_END_DATE, PROCESSING_SECTOR) %>%
      mutate(prop_outside_wk = tons_gf_wk / sum(tons_gf_wk)) %>% ungroup()

    net_change_calc <- rates_props %>%
      left_join(gf_inside, by=c("YEAR", "WEEK_END_DATE", "PROCESSING_SECTOR")) %>%
      mutate(new_PSC_wk = (tons_gf_inside_wk * prop_outside_wk) * mean_psc_rate_wk) %>%
      group_by(YEAR) %>%
      summarise(psc_change = sum(new_PSC_wk, na.rm=TRUE) - sum(psc_inside_wk, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    status_quo_annual <- catch_df %>% 
      group_by(YEAR) %>% 
      summarise(psc_statusquo = sum(PSC_TOTAL_COUNT), .groups = "drop")
    
    final_summary <- status_quo_annual %>%
      left_join(net_change_calc, by="YEAR") %>%
      mutate(net_new_PSC = psc_statusquo + coalesce(psc_change, 0))

    return(list(
      catch_map = catch_data2,
      closure_geom = closure_agg,
      summary_df = final_summary
    ))
  })

  output$gfPlot <- renderPlot({
    res <- analysis_results()
    ggplot() +
      geom_spatvector(data = res$catch_map, aes(fill = GF_TOTAL_CATCH_MT), alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = "GnBu", name = "Catch (MT)") +
      geom_spatvector(data = res$closure_geom, color = "red", fill = NA, lwd = 1) +
      facet_wrap(~WEEK_END_DATE, ncol = 5) +
      theme_minimal()
  })

  output$pscPlot <- renderPlot({
    res <- analysis_results()
    ggplot() +
      geom_spatvector(data = res$catch_map, aes(fill = PSC_TOTAL_COUNT), alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Reds", name = "PSC Count") +
      geom_spatvector(data = res$closure_geom, color = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1) +
      facet_wrap(~WEEK_END_DATE, ncol = 5) +
      theme_minimal()
  })

  output$summaryPlot <- renderPlot({
    res <- analysis_results()
    plot_data <- res$summary_df %>% 
      pivot_longer(cols = c("psc_statusquo", "net_new_PSC"), 
                   names_to = "psc_type", values_to = "psc_amount")
    
    ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(YEAR), y = psc_amount, fill = psc_type)) + 
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("psc_statusquo" = "#1f78b4", "net_new_PSC" = "#a6cee3"),
                        labels = c("Status Quo", "Closure Scenario"), name = "Scenario") +
      labs(x = "Year", y = "Total PSC (# Fish)") +
      theme_minimal()
  })

  output$summaryTable <- renderTable({
    analysis_results()$summary_df
  })
}

# --- 4. LAUNCH ---
shinyApp(ui, server)
